about_the_game:
Welcome to a world where glamour is currency and self-irony is an investment. This DLC outfits your tools with audacious style, because when you look like a million bucks, why play by anyone else’s rules? Includes:

  • Glamoo-r Wash: "Spill the tea, not the glitter! This machine handles your delicates with dramatic flair."

  • Rubber & Claws: "Beauty isn’t a weakness. It’s a warning. Handle with care, darling."

  • Sugarblade: "Sweetly sharp, dangerously chic. This isn't just a tool, it's a statement."

Note: This DLC contains cosmetic items only and does not affect gameplay.
